answer_1.quote: We implement human evaluation to assess responses on Forgetting (Forget.), Relevance (Rel.), and Fluency (Flu.) using a discrete rating scale of 1 to 5... We evaluate our method on two benchmark datasets: TOFU and KnowUnDo, and also incorporate generic data from WikiQA and Chatbot Instruction.
answer_1.outputs: Generated textual responses to privacy-sensitive QA prompts

answer_2.quote: We propose a comprehensive evaluation framework comprising three metrics: Knowledge Forgetting Ratio (KFR), Knowledge Retention Ratio (KRR), and Linguistic Score (LS). LS is computed as the harmonic mean of Perplexity (PPL), Brunet's Index (BI) and Honore's Statistic (HS). To assess fluency and relevance, we employ GPT Score, generated by GPT-4o, ranging from 1 to 5.

answer_3.quote: To assess fluency (Flu.) and relevance (Rel.), we employ GPT Score, generated by GPT-4o, ranging from 1 to 5.
